proxy.traefik:
# Traefik reference config for lychee, generated by the hub from its image.yml.
# Labels for the lychee service in your compose file. Traefik's docker provider must reach the lychee
# container on a shared network; the entrypoint websecure and the certificate resolver letsencrypt are
# examples from a typical Traefik setup. Replace example.com with your domain. Websockets need nothing extra.
services:
  lychee:
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.http.services.lychee.loadbalancer.server.port=80
      - traefik.http.routers.lychee.rule=Host(`lychee.example.com`)
      - traefik.http.routers.lychee.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.lychee.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.lychee.service=lychee
      # Authentication: uncomment one; the middleware is defined in your Traefik config.
      # - traefik.http.routers.lychee.middlewares=authelia@docker
      # - traefik.http.routers.lychee.middlewares=authentik@docker

kubernetes:
# Lychee: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-lychee/blob/master/image.yml
# Storage sizes are placeholders; secrets belong in a Secret, not this ConfigMap.
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: lychee-env
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: lychee
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
data:
  PUID: '1000'
  PGID: '1000'
  TZ: Etc/UTC
  DB_CONNECTION: ''
  DB_HOST: ''
  DB_PORT: ''
  DB_USERNAME: ''
  DB_PASSWORD: ''
  DB_DATABASE: ''
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: lychee-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: lychee
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: lychee-pictures
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: lychee
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: lychee
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: lychee
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: lychee
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: lychee
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: lychee
        image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/lychee:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: lychee-env
        ports:
        - name: port-80
          containerPort: 80
          protocol: TCP
        volumeMounts:
        - name: lychee-config
          mountPath: /config
        - name: lychee-pictures
          mountPath: /pictures
      volumes:
      - name: lychee-config
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: lychee-config
      - name: lychee-pictures
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: lychee-pictures
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: lychee
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: lychee
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: lychee
  ports:
  - name: port-80
    port: 80
    targetPort: 80
    protocol: TCP
quadlet:
# lychee.container: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-lychee/blob/master/image.yml
# Optional parameters are commented out.

[Unit]
Description=Lychee (LinuxServer.io)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Container]
Image=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/lychee:latest
ContainerName=lychee
AutoUpdate=registry
Environment=PUID=1000
Environment=PGID=1000
Environment=TZ=Etc/UTC
Environment=DB_CONNECTION=
Environment=DB_HOST=
Environment=DB_PORT=
Environment=DB_USERNAME=
Environment=DB_PASSWORD=
Environment=DB_DATABASE=
# Environment=APP_NAME=Lychee
# Environment=APP_URL=
# Environment=TRUSTED_PROXIES=
Volume=/path/to/lychee/config:/config:Z
Volume=/path/to/pictures:/pictures:Z
PublishPort=80:80

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
